blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

items.t: Simon Fraser University Area real estate

faq.q: Where is Greentree Village in Burnaby?
faq.a: On Burnaby's south slope around Marlborough Avenue and Sussex Avenue, near École Marlborough Elementary, west of Metrotown; "Greentree Village" is the GVR MLS® sub-area name, matching the local townhome pocket (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What sold in Greentree Village in September 2026?
faq.a: Both of the sub-area's 2 condos & townhomes listings sold (a 100% sales ratio on a tiny 2-listing sample — not a meaningful market rate), and the single detached listing did not sell, so the detached ratio is not applicable. Burnaby-wide, the median detached sale price was $1,825,000 and the condos & townhomes median was $686,000 that month (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which school is in Greentree Village?
faq.a: École Marlborough Elementary (K–7), 6060 Marlborough Ave — a French Immersion program school; Immersion entry is application-based, and the catchment for any specific address must be checked in the SD41 School Locator.

faq.q: Is there a SkyTrain station in Greentree Village?
faq.a: No — Royal Oak Station on the Expo Line, north-west of the pocket, is the SkyTrain link for this area.
